Every title on the list, formatted in Chicago author-date style by Quarto's citation processor from the CSL JSON file the build script generates. The same file imports into Zotero; the BibTeX version is in the repository's `exports/` folder. If a reference here differs from the citation line on a section page, the data is right and one of the two renderers is wrong, so please tell us.
